headline: Middle East Supply Disruptions Upend Global Natural Gas Forecasts
summary: Middle East LNG supply shortages have upended near-term natural gas demand forecasts and import costs. European and Asian economies are increasingly turning to coal and renewables to offset expensive gas.
why: Liquefied natural gas is a critical fuel for power generation worldwide, and prolonged supply shortages can alter utility input costs and sovereign energy policies.

impacts.name: Natural Gas
impacts.why: Reduced LNG supply from the Middle East tightens global availability and lifts import expenses.
